roadmap.goal: Story 6457 (FE7): frontend tests run in milliseconds where they can, and a guard keeps them fast. Behaviour-free test infrastructure: a Vitest time-budget reporter with a ratcheting allow-list of named slow tests (slice 1a), the per-file budget made enforceable (1b), a measure-only configuration spike (2), adoption of the winning configuration only (3), eight rewrite slices that move logic into directly tested functions and cut render and wait cost (4 to 11), and a sweep with the closing measurements and the single end-of-Story Stryker run (12). No production behaviour changes (production edits are pure extractions only), no assertion is lost (moved-assertions list per slice), no Playwright or screenshot file is touched. Payoff is measured by the lead (touched-files alternating runs per slice, one quiet-machine wall median at the end, allow-list length, CI Duration median), never asserted by a test.
roadmap.rigor: standard for every slice (crafter and designer sonnet, reviewer haiku): agreed for the whole test track at its AFK entry, recorded in the T1 workspace; no per-slice raise. The model is passed explicitly on every dispatch.
preconditions: P-ws (lead): working directory for every command is Lighthouse.Frontend; the workspace is docs/feature/story-6457-fe7-fast-frontend-tests (called the workspace below). Measurement artefacts go under workspace/measurement/. Files marked (create) in files_to_modify do not exist yet.

P-quiet (lead): steps whose name contains QUIET MACHINE need a quiet system: no other pnpm test, dotnet test, IDE test run or heavy session; dotnet build-server shutdown beforehand; LIGHTHOUSE_TEST_WORKERS=6 exported (01-02's oversubscribed runs override it with 12 for those runs only). The lead pauses and asks the maintainer for a quiet machine before each such step and does not dispatch a crafter for it. QUIET MACHINE steps: 01-02, 01-09, 03-01, 03-02, 03-03, 04-02, 13-03, 13-04.

P-slice-figures (lead): EXCEPTION to the quiet-machine rule: rewrite-slice close figures (every NN-02 step, the 12-01 profile and the 13-02 sweep) are NOT quiet-machine measurements. Rationale: alternating before and after runs of the same touched files within minutes puts the same load on both arms, so the relative change is meaningful while absolute seconds are not; every close report labels its figure 'indicative (not quiet)' and uses 5 pairs. Rewrite slices (phases 05 to 12) do NOT need a quiet machine. Per-slice before and after figures are measured by running only the slice's touched test files, before and after alternating (5 pairs, same minute, same worker count; labelled 'indicative (not quiet)'), so any load from a parallel session hits both arms alike. The close report gives summed seconds before and after, the relative change, allow-list length, and tests added and removed, and replaces the slice's estimate with the measured relative figure. The suite wall median is a figure of step 13-03 only (quiet). This amends the earlier per-slice rule and the local-arm protocol.

P-crafter-warn: once the reporter is wired (from step 01-07 on), every crafter step's full pnpm test runs with LIGHTHOUSE_TIME_BUDGET=warn, because a parallel session's load can produce false offenders. Crafter runs prove correctness and test ids, not timing. Timing verdicts come only from QUIET MACHINE steps, where the guard enforces.

P-ci-artifacts (lead): step 01-02 needs the test-timings-frontend artifacts of at least 5 main runs (7 are saved under workspace/measurement/ci-artifacts-2026-11-02/). If fewer than 5 are usable the step stops and asks; there is no fallback budget value.

P-push (lead): one push per slice, green first. Slice 1a does not edit a workflow file and so does not force the full backend, E2E and live-connector suites. Slice 1b edits ci_frontend.yml and does: the lead announces it and keeps the shared Linear key quiet. Slice 2's CI arms are throwaway features/** branches, each a full verify run with live connectors, one per passing candidate, never near another connector run. Crafters push nothing.

P-activation: the 79 acceptance tests in src/tests/timeBudget are under describe.skip and RED on stubs. Steps 01-03 to 01-06 remove the skips and go green one test at a time, in this split: compare part one (not-listed, exact-key and listed groups), compare part two (stale and mode groups, kept skipped by their own inner skip until 01-04), observe (11), options (21). Counts: compare 47, options 21, observe 11. No skip survives step 01-04, 01-05 or 01-06 respectively.

P-rewrite-contract: every rewrite slice (phases 05 to 12) follows the behaviour-free contract in the feature-delta: universe and preserved set declared first; every removed or shrunk expect( has a row in the moved-assertions list (counted per file with git diff -U0 and grep); preserved ids come from a run, never from source; the extraction commit changes no test and the unmodified page tests pass at it; no added skip, todo, only, fails, loosened matcher or longer timeout; coverage of the touched directory not lower, run apart from timing runs; no production file outside the named extractions, no Playwright spec, no screenshot file and no setupTests.ts in the diff (git diff --name-only is a subset of the declared universe); the slice deletes the slowTests.ts entries it fixes in the same commit as the tests; CI=true pnpm run sonarreport run once over the touched test files.

P-allow-list-text: slowTests.ts carries no slice, story or decision id. Each entry has a plain-language reason and a ceiling only. Which slice retires which entry is recorded in the feature-delta (retirement mapping, written in 01-08 and kept current by each rewrite slice).

P-order: slices 4 to 11 (phases 05 to 12) may be reordered or dropped by measured payoff after slice 3; the lead decides and records it. Slice 10 follows slice 4. Slice 11 follows FE5's split of BaseMetricsView (an external predecessor) if that has landed; otherwise it leaves that file and ratchets it. If a slice is dropped, its steps are removed here and phase 13 is re-pointed to the last shipped rewrite step.

P-ci-reads (lead): CI after-measurement is not per slice. It is taken passively after phase 04 (step 04-03, because configuration is the change expected to move CI wall time) and at the end (step 13-05), as the median of at least 5 qualifying main runs each time. Rewrite slices get their payoff from the touched-files figure; their pushes still count toward the runs that 04-03 and 13-05 read.

P-mutation: Stryker (frontend) runs once, in step 13-04, on frozen code, over the production files touched by extractions; kill rate not lower than before the Story, at least 80 percent for new code. Check the mutate list and the runner include first. The reporter, compare step and options function are test infrastructure and are not mutated.

P-rollback: LIGHTHOUSE_TIME_BUDGET=warn|off switches the reporter in CI with no commit (off means the reporter judges nothing; the earlier wording that off loads nothing is superseded); LIGHTHOUSE_BUDGET_WARN_ONLY=true restores warn-only for the per-file half. Every slice reverts alone; a rewrite revert re-adds that slice's slowTests.ts entries in the same commit.
Rationale and implementation detail per step is in feature-delta.md, section 'Wave: DELIVER / [REF] Roadmap notes', keyed by step id, with a 'Revision after review (2026-11-03)' sub-section.
